description: The output \(r(\bar x,n)=b\) exists exactly when a finite chain \(a_0,\ldots,a_n\) starts at a defined value of \(g(\bar x)\), ends at \(b\), and every intervening step \(h(\bar x,i,a_i)=a_{i+1}\) is defined.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.recursion_chain_iff {k : ℕ}
  (g : Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.PFunction k)
  (h : Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.PFunction (k + 2))
  (x : Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.Args k) (n b : ℕ) :
  b ∈
      Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.partialRec g h
        (Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.snoc x n) ↔
    ∃ a,
      a 0 ∈ g x ∧
        a (Fin.last n) = b ∧
          ∀ (i : Fin n),
            a i.succ ∈
              h
                (Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.snoc
                  (Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PartialRecursiveFunctions.snoc x ↑i) (a i.castSucc))
